projects.Title: Contest Tracker
projects.Description: Contest Tracker is a full-stack MERN application designed for competitive programmers to track 100+ coding contests across platforms like Codeforces, CodeChef, and LeetCode. Designed optimized MongoDB schemas with indexing, reducing database query time by 65% (1.2s to 400ms). Developed 15+ REST APIs with pagination and filtering for efficient, scalable contest retrieval.
Features: Tracks 100+ coding contests across Codeforces, CodeChef, and LeetCode
Optimized MongoDB schemas with indexing reducing query response time by 65%
Improved API response time from 1.2s to 400ms
15+ REST APIs with pagination and filtering for scalable contest retrieval
Bookmark functionality for saving upcoming contests
Dark/light mode UI theme switching
Responsive design for mobile and desktop viewports

projects.Title: SociaLink
projects.Description: SociaLink is a real-time chat system with efficient message storage, real-time bidirectional communication, JWT authentication, and media handling. Built with Socket.IO, Express, Node.js, and MongoDB.
Features: Real-time bidirectional communication using Socket.IO events
Secure backend APIs with JWT authentication, HTTP-only cookies, and protected routes
Scalable MongoDB schemas for users, messages, and activity tracking
Cloudinary integration for media handling and image uploads
Responsive user interface designed for web and mobile

projects.Title: UrbanBeat Youth Discovery
projects.Description: UrbanBeat is a responsive youth culture and event discovery platform developed during Inglu Global internship. Designed with a glassmorphism UI, interactive event cards, sticky navigation, Web3Forms API email integration, and lazy loading performance optimization.
Features: Responsive glassmorphism UI with interactive event cards and smooth animations
Web3Forms API integration for asynchronous contact & newsletter submissions
Client-side validation and email notifications
Lazy loading and frontend performance optimizations
Maintained using Git/GitHub and deployed on Vercel

projects.Title: NitroStack Open Source Contribution
projects.Description: Open-source contribution merged into NitroStack repository (PR #262). Improved accessibility for NitroStack's MCP documentation interface, preserving existing manual theme preferences while improving dark-mode and reduced-motion accessibility.
Features: Merged PR #262 improving accessibility for NitroStack MCP docs
Preserved manual theme preferences while adding dark-mode & reduced-motion accessibility
Validated with 577/577 tests passing across 50 test suites
